label: Epic Fantasy
context_hint: Grand, mythic scale — sweeping vistas, ancient architecture, magic woven into the world's fabric (glowing runes, elemental effects, otherworldly creatures). Cinematic, painterly lighting with strong atmospheric depth (mist, god-rays, distant mountains). Costumes and settings are richly detailed and historically inspired but fantastical. The tone is heroic and awe-inspiring, never mundane. This is a mood and setting filter, not a plot instruction — a quiet, contemplative beat (resting, studying a map, a still conversation) should stay quiet and simply be dressed in this grandeur; save mid-action framing (crossing a threshold, drawing a weapon, summoning magic) for when the narrative direction actually calls for movement.
